title: W11169652 — Component activation: dry blower
description: Activate dry blower for live verification.

steps.title: Console control panel?
steps.body: Console models use membrane buttons and a seven-segment display. LCD-in-door models use the TOOLS menu and touchscreen — answer No for those.

steps.title: Console — enter Service Diagnostic mode
steps.body: Enter Service Diagnostic mode. Console load-test chart has no dedicated dry-blower function — use LCD Component Activation when available, or verify blower operation during Quick Service Cycle step 010 on LCD models after repair.

steps.title: LCD — enter Service Diagnostic mode
steps.body: Enter DIAGNOSTICS HOME via TOOLS → INFO → SERVICE & SUPPORT (password 123 × 3).

steps.title: LCD — activate dry blower
steps.body: Component Activation → turn Dry Blower ON (or run Quick Service Cycle and watch step 010 — Dry Blower). Confirm blower wheel/airflow. Toggle OFF when finished.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Dry Blower — If no airflow, see TEST #17: Dry Blower Motor.
